tonight.headline: Tuten is likely out tonight — start Kamara now
body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten missed all three practices, and every one of the 27 players in Liam Coen's tenure who did that also missed the game (SI, 5 Nov). He plays at Baltimore tonight at 19:15 and locks at kickoff. Garrett Wilson is still in the concussion protocol, DNP Wednesday. Kyler Murray, Jefferson's quarterback, is a coin flip for Monday.
As set AVIATO project 125.7 against Talla Metralla's 130.1. Swap Kamara in for Tuten now; if Tuten is on the active list at 17:45, put him back.

case.label: Why not wait for 17:45
case.body: The check works only if someone looks at a Thursday 17:45 inactive list. Benching him now makes the safe answer the default: if he plays, one tap restores him before 19:15; if nobody looks, Kamara's Sunday game is still open.

case.label: Their week
case.body: Talla Metralla start Derrick Henry against rookie Joe Fagnano tonight, Burrow in the early London-time game, and Kelce, limited Wednesday with an ankle called maintenance (Yahoo 4 Nov).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten is active, nobody restores him, and he outscores Kamara (archive).

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Before Thu 5 Nov 19:15 CDMX (Tuten locks at kickoff)
doFirst.title: Start Kamara, bench Tuten — restore Tuten only if he is active
doFirst.subtitle: No practice all week. In Coen's tenure, 27 of 27 players who did that sat.

case.label: The news
case.body: Tuten (foot/ankle) did not practise Monday, Tuesday or Wednesday; Coen said he 'feels better' and called it a game-time decision (Jaguars.com 4 Nov). John Shipley's count: all 27 Coen-era players who missed every practice that week also missed the game (SI, 5 Nov 10:45Z). Heavy (5 Nov) add that even if active he may not play a full snap count.

case.label: Why this beats the projection
case.body: ESPN's 15.4 is a full-game projection; it does not price a likely inactive. This is the one kind of override the strategy allows — news, named and dated, about availability. Not points, not volume.

case.label: The cover
case.body: Kamara (11.2) DNP Wednesday on a listed rest day for his back (Saints.com 4 Nov); he plays Sunday, so if Friday goes against him, Allgeier (9.3) still has time to step in.

case.label: If he is active
case.body: Inactives come out about 17:50 CDMX. If Tuten is on the active list, put him back over Kamara before 19:15 — 15.4 against 11.2 is a real gap if he plays a full game.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten plays, stays benched, and outscores Kamara in Week 9 (archive).

case.body: Hit on the second-to-last play at Las Vegas, symptoms Monday, protocol since; DNP Wednesday, day-to-day (Jets report and ESPN/Cimini 4 Nov). Independent clearance decides; Friday's designation is the first real answer.

case.label: The cover
case.body: Kamara now holds Tuten's RB slot, so the next back is Allgeier (9.3): Arizona's lead with Love on IR, Minshew at quarterback (CBS 3 Nov; azcardinals.com 4 Nov). Diggs moves from FLEX to WR. If Tuten played Thursday, Kamara is the FLEX instead.

worthALook.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
worthALook.lead: Tuten's backup, a free agent, and Jacksonville are 10-point favourites tonight.

case.label: The player
case.body: Hand injury with no game status; takes most early-down work if Tuten sits, with LeQuint Allen Jr. and Abdullah also in line (Jaguars.com 4 Nov; Heavy 5 Nov). JAX -10, implied ~24.75 (TheLines 5 Nov).

case.label: The cost
case.body: The only seat is Etienne's, claimed by the owner yesterday — reversing a day-old move is the churn the strategy forbids unless the player is ruled out, and Etienne is on IR. It also spends Etienne's Week 11 upside on one night.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: Kamara already covers the slot. Rodriguez's 5.6 assumes Tuten plays; even inheriting the early downs he shares with two backs.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuten ruled out before 17:45 and Kamara downgraded Friday — then he is the better tonight-start than waiting on Kamara's back, at Etienne's seat.
